name: Weekly Paclitaxel (single agent)

institution.provenance: StewardMD DRAFT single-agent option authored in-house from standard-of-care oncology; experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated.

premedications.name: Hypersensitivity prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Corticosteroid, H1- and H2-antihistamine before paclitaxel; weekly schedules often use attenuated steroid premedication after tolerance is established.

supportiveCare: Peripheral sensory neuropathy is cumulative and dose-limiting: assess each cycle and reduce/hold for grade 2-3.
Monitor for infusion reactions, myelosuppression, and arthralgia/myalgia.

drugs.name: Paclitaxel
drugs.notes: Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV weekly on days 1, 8 and 15 every 28 days (a continuous weekly schedule is also used), for platinum-resistant relapse; may be combined with bevacizumab. Hold/reduce for grade 2-3 neuropathy. Authored in StewardMD's words from standard-of-care oncology (NCCN/DeVita general reference).
